description: This file defines the interface 'StagingTableCatalog' for Spark's table catalog implementations that support staging creation and replacement of tables to enable atomic operations in CREATE TABLE AS SELECT and REPLACE TABLE AS SELECT workflows.

classes.name: StagingTableCatalog
classes.description: An interface extending TableCatalog that supports staging creation and replacement of tables for atomic operations in Spark SQL.

methods.name: stageCreate
methods.description: Stages the creation of a table with specified identifier, schema, partitions, and properties; deprecated versions accept different parameters.

methods.name: stageReplace
methods.description: Stages the replacement of a table with specified identifier, schema, partitions, and properties; deprecated versions accept different parameters.

methods.name: stageCreateOrReplace
methods.description: Stages creation or replacement of a table with specified identifier and table info; deprecated versions accept different parameters.

methods.name: supportedCustomMetrics
methods.description: Returns an array of custom metrics supported by the catalog for reporting after commit.
